answer_value: Only conclusions I and II follow
steps: I: spoons (non-empty) are knives, so some knives are spoons - follows
II: forks ⊂ knives, disjoint from spatulas - follows
III: spoons disjoint from spatulas - does not follow
check_code:
from itertools import product
# regions over (spoon,fork,knife,spatula); each region present or not
regs=list(product([0,1],repeat=4))
res={'I':True,'II':True,'III':True}; n=0
for mask in product([0,1],repeat=len(regs)):
    R=[r for r,m in zip(regs,mask) if m]
    if not any(r[0] for r in R): continue  # spoons non-empty
    if any(r[0] and not r[1] for r in R): continue
    if any(r[1] and not r[2] for r in R): continue
    if any(r[2] and r[3] for r in R): continue
    if not any(r[1] for r in R) or not any(r[2] for r in R) or not any(r[3] for r in R): continue
    n+=1
    res['I']&=any(r[2] and r[0] for r in R)
    res['II']&=not any(r[1] and r[3] for r in R)
    res['III']&=any(r[0] and r[3] for r in R)
assert n>0
follows={k for k,v in res.items() if v}
opts={'A':set(),'B':{'III'},'C':{'I','II'},'D':{'I'}}
assert [k for k,v in opts.items() if v==follows]==['C']

from itertools import product
regs=list(product([0,1],repeat=4))  # (M,D,P,T)
res={'I':True,'II':True}; n=0
for mask in product([0,1],repeat=len(regs)):
    R=[r for r,m in zip(regs,mask) if m]
    if not any(r[0] and r[1] for r in R): continue
    if any(r[1] and r[2] for r in R): continue
    if any(r[2] and not r[3] for r in R): continue
    if not all(any(r[i] for r in R) for i in range(4)): continue
    n+=1
    res['I']&=any(r[0] and r[2] for r in R)
    res['II']&=any(r[1] and r[3] for r in R)
assert n>0
follows={k for k,v in res.items() if v}
opts={'A':set(),'B':{'I'},'C':{'I','II'},'D':{'II'}}
assert [k for k,v in opts.items() if v==follows]==['A']
